draft_en.subject: A sample against your current ONV unit - the PoE switches under the Atlantis label
draft_en.body:
Hi Daniela,

We wrote to you once in February 2025 about an 8-port industrial PoE switch, and since then only general product mails - most recently "Industrial PoE Switch" on 16 September 2026 - none of which needed an answer. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches sold under the Atlantis label (ONV-built today), a second ODM source in your packaging from small lots, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $145.7; 802.3bt ports on request. Samples are paid at the same price.

One question: which PoE SKU would you want sampled against your current ONV unit first?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
